001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy;
002
003import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
004
005public enum EconomyType {
006  /*
007   * UNKNOWN = FALLBACK TO VAULT
008   * VAULT = USE VAULT API
009   * RESERVE = USE RESERVE API
010   * */
011  UNKNOWN(-1),
012  VAULT(0),
013  RESERVE(1),
014  //MIXED(2),
015  GEMS_ECONOMY(3),
016  TNE(4),
017  COINS_ENGINE(5),
018  TREASURY(6);
019
020  private final int id;
021
022  EconomyType(final int id) {
023
024    this.id = id;
025  }
026
027  @NotNull
028  public static EconomyType fromID(final int id) {
029
030    for(final EconomyType type : EconomyType.values()) {
031      if(type.id == id) {
032        return type;
033      }
034    }
035    return UNKNOWN;
036  }
037
038  public static int toID(@NotNull final EconomyType economyType) {
039
040    return economyType.id;
041  }
042
043  public int toID() {
044
045    return id;
046  }
047}
